To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the friction force curve can be explained by real contact area, and temperature is related to friction force.
the friction force evolution is affected by the temperature and the contact area, and the temperature is increased by the friction force.
the columnar approach model is a good model to explain the atomic scale friction process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the physical characteristics of friction process in columnar approach separation mode.
the physical characteristics of the columnar approach friction model.
the friction process of a columnar separation model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the friction process is a combination of the adhesion and the breakage, which is a typical process of the columnar approach.
the columnar approach model can be applied to explain the friction force evolution and the microstructures of sliding interface.
the friction force is related to real contact area, tangential stress, adhesion and the temperature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the friction force and temperature are increased during the initial transient sliding period, and the friction force decreases with time due to the decrease of real contact area and the increase of adhesion.
the friction force is determined by the contact area, tangential stress and the adhesion.
a columnar approach separation mechanism is proposed, which is based on the adhesion theory and the MD simulation result.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the friction force is related to the contact area with tangental force, the friction force is not only the function of the real contact area but also the tangential force.
the temperature change is related to the adhesion.
we provide a new method of understanding the atomic scale friction, and we can predict the friction force and the frictional behavior by the simulation.
